_comment: P3 (frozen shape, schemas/template.schema.json). The workspace_templates entry `ext.export_template` writes for the Board Surface of Team Tasks; the snapshot itself (templates/team-board/snapshot.json + objects/ + chunks/) is produced by the service from a real Workspace and is not checked in here. `digest` covers every file under templates/team-board/. Creating a Workspace loads the snapshot as a new Workspace, replaces {{params.team_name}} and empties the tasks table.
